v3_search_rules.search_by_construct: Two-route strategy E AND (I OR O) unchanged from v2; the open window is an organising construct and is not searched as a phrase (contract §3, ruling 8.3a).
v3_search_rules.open_window_terms_role: OR supplement inside the I block or citation-chasing source only; never an AND term, filter or eligibility criterion. If an OR supplement line is used, log it as a separate search-history line within the EI entry and record its marginal yield during seed testing.
v3_search_rules.open_window_phrase_evidence: 18 PubMed title/abstract records 2018-2026 combine "open window"/"open-window" with exercise and immune terms (02_preliminary/collision_recheck_2026-10-04.md §6 query a; reconnaissance, not a protocol search).
v3_search_rules.organising_window: 0-72 h after cessation of an identifiable bout, applied at screening/charting; not a search limit or inclusion cap. Samples > 72 h are extracted and tagged outside-window recovery; no new exclusion code.
v3_search_rules.population_rule_applied_at_screening: Adults >= 18 y; mixed-age cohorts only with a separable adult stratum; < 18 y excluded under FT03; older adults included and flagged as a subgroup.
v3_search_rules.exposure_rule: No intensity, duration or mode threshold; these are recorded at extraction and used as evidence-map strata.
v3_search_rules.support_B: Retained (cross-bout open-window monitoring layer); applied at screening.
v3_search_rules.T_block_role: Diagnostic sensitivity/precision comparison only (search_strategy_draft.txt §8); never part of the main EI/EO query.
v3_search_rules.pilot_timing: 50-record screening pilot runs after the v3.0 archive release (GitHub Release + Zenodo version DOI) on a preserved draft search pool; formal five-database search starts only after the archived release exists.

notes: All hit, export, and test-detection fields are null because no formal five-database search, seed test, citation chasing, registry-overlap check or platform pilot has been run.

The v3 design contract (01_protocol/v3_design_contract.txt; v2 carry-overs unchanged) states databases/full text are available and a second human reviewer is confirmed; it does not mean an execution or PRESS reviewer is already assigned.

No language, date, age, human or exercise-intensity restrictions are planned. Review, animal, youth, disease, protocol and preprint eligibility, and position relative to the 0-72 h organising window, are handled at screening or in the parallel register, not by a filter.

Preprint, citation-chain and registry-overlap records are kept separate from core five-database counts. All query/result fields remain null because none was executed. The 2026-10-04 collision re-check is prior reconnaissance and populates none of these fields.

Protocol v3.0 (draft for team freeze) dated 2026-10-04; strategy v0.4-draft. Parsed queries, run-query/export checksums, route-level seed detection (including the v3 seeds POS-C*, BND-*, CIT-*), final dates and hit counts remain null until genuine execution.

preprints.if_cap_or_ambiguous_parser: split F1/F2 into term combinations; if still capped mark incomplete
preprints.stop: all results from both queries screened, plausible full texts checked; no ranked-result cutoff

citation_chasing.initial_round: backward and forward for included primary reports and closest relevant reviews
citation_chasing.trigger: any newly included eligible report becomes a seed for another full round
citation_chasing.stop: one full round adds zero eligible reports
citation_chasing.if_additions_in_final_round: mark saturation NOT REACHED and document queue; do not claim closure
citation_chasing.submission_update: within 30 days before submission; repeat if delayed beyond 30 days

registry_overlap_check.stop: inspect visible matches or log cap/coverage limitation

embase_platform_rule: Select Embase.com OR Ovid as one of five databases; alternative interface is a translation option, not a sixth source.

execution_gate.note: No formal run until these gates are recorded; platform validation tests are logged separately from formal search/update runs.

selected_embase_platform_status: PENDING; no Embase interface selected or searched
alternative_embase_platform_status: Ovid/Embase.com is an alternative interface translation only; do not count it as a sixth database or execute both unless protocol is amended
